INSERT INTO delphi_rule_effects (
            revision,
            detail_id,
            rule_id,
            severity,
            hidden
        )
        SELECT $1, effect.*
        FROM UNNEST(
            $2::BIGINT[],
            $3::BIGINT[],
            $4::delphi_severity[],
            $5::BOOLEAN[]
        ) AS effect(detail_id, rule_id, severity, hidden)
